title: Common providers: Denmark
coverage: Complete for the national carriers, the mobile network operators and the main fibre and cable operators; the regional energy-company fibre networks and business ISPs are partial.
missing: Other regional energy-company fibre networks and the local antenna associations
AS numbers for 3 and OpenNet (none confirmed)
A website for Energi Fyn (it refused an automated read on the read date)

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 19 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number registered to the provider but not announced was left out.

sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

providers.name: TDC Erhverv
providers.notes: The retail side of the former TDC: TDC Erhverv for business, YouSee for homes. Its company was Nuuday and is now TDC Brands.

providers.name: TDC NET
providers.notes: The network side of the former TDC: copper, cable, fibre and mobile network; wholesale. AS3292 is registered to TDC Holding, the former group; it is given here because TDC NET runs the network.

providers.name: Norlys
providers.notes: Energy company with fibre, cable and mobile. It bought Telia's Danish business in 2024; AS3308 was Telia Danmark's number, AS8273 Stofa's.

providers.name: GlobalConnect
providers.notes: Nordic fibre group, also in the Sweden and Finland packs.

providers.name: Waoo
providers.notes: Internet and TV brand on energy-company fibre networks.

providers.name: Ewii
providers.notes: Fibre in the Triangle Region. AS204151 is the Kviknet brand.

providers.name: OpenNet
providers.notes: Wholesale platform for the fibre networks; seldom the name on the bill.

providers.name: DeiC
providers.notes: Runs Forskningsnettet, the national research and education network.
